objectives.description: Write tests/test-books-gate.sh following test-books-certify.sh harness conventions; all 11 planned cases plus derivation and private-import cases
objectives.note: 44 assertions, 0 failed. Cases: lint_unavailable; pass_vacuous (0 of 2, never collapsed to pass); pass (2 of 2); rule_set_error (library exit 1 on source, wrapper shell survives = subshell proof); usage_error (absent named root, exit 0); wrapper's own unknown-argument error (exit 2, distinct); planted public import -> exactly 1 violation with the offending path; public meta import form; specs/-pathed negative; .lake/-pathed negative; provider_absent; planted [[require]] reported; private import counted as context not violation; derived package roots with a components/* lacking lean/ excluded; advisory exit-0 invariant over 7 fixture roots.

Seven probes (A-G), one per predicate: vacuity, exit-1 stderr classification, specs/ pruning, .lake/ pruning, provider-require count, lint_unavailable, provider_absent. Each demonstrably produces a DIFFERENT result when its predicate's input is forged, printed in the suite output (e.g. probeA got 'pass' where the real case expects 'pass_vacuous'; probeC got 'violations' where the real case expects 'pass').
